purpose: Freeze exactly one source-aligned, raw-only implementation candidate for C0/D initialization and direct Doppler velocity handoff after the Phase90 blocker audit.

allowed_change.d_initializer: For each retained problem epoch i, initialize D_i from that same-run epoch's EpochSeed.receiver_clock_drift_mps.
allowed_change.d_coverage_gate: Require one finite raw drift value for every retained epoch; fail closed on missing, nonfinite, count-mismatched, or reordered values.
allowed_change.epoch_alignment: Use the same retained problem epoch sequence and source timestamp identity; do not align by vector position across independently rebuilt problems.
allowed_change.velocity_handoff: Use the existing direct FGOProblem::doppler_velocity_wls_estimates handoff without changing its equations, quality gates, physical gates, or coverage accounting.
allowed_change.coordinate_policy: Handoff velocity only; do not copy GNSS-first position or clock states and do not derive D from coordinates, position differences, or a base solution.
allowed_change.telemetry: Expose only diagnostics proving D provenance, units, finite/count coverage, direct-WLS acceptance/rejection, and unchanged C0/D factor accounting.

required_focused_tests_before_execution_: Synthetic finite DriftNanosPerSecond conversion produces the expected metres-per-second D seed.
Synthetic missing/nonfinite/count-mismatched/reordered raw drift fails closed with no zero or hold fallback.
Synthetic direct-WLS accepted velocity-only handoff preserves positions_clocks_copied=0 and source epoch count.
Synthetic direct-WLS over-70 and over-2000 states remain rejected and cannot be clipped, replaced, or propagated to pass coverage.
Synthetic C0/D factor verifies unchanged equation, Jacobian, sigma, row skip, and phone-exclusion invariants.
Diagnostics prove candidate selector does not enable PDC or any coordinate bridge.
required_gates_before_any_future_raw_exe: Implementation and focused tests are committed separately from this freeze.
A separate pre-raw execution manifest pins source, binary, evaluator, candidate, and exact route matrix.
The evaluator fails closed on missing D telemetry, iterations below one, nonfinite costs, or final cost not strictly below initial cost.
Only a later manifest may authorize raw routes; this freeze itself authorizes none.
No truth, MAT, Kaggle, token, base, validation-holdout, Phase82, or precomputed-coordinate reads are permitted.
candidate.evidence_limit: Phase40 reports zero valid direct-WLS coverage on MTV-h; this candidate is an implementation hypothesis supported by source-unit parity and does not claim route readiness or accuracy improvement.

forbidden_inputs_and_paths: precomputed coordinates or Phase82 coordinate artifacts
velocity clipping, interpolation, padding, reordering, or rejected-state substitution
source sigma, optimizer, physical-bound, rank, residual, or coverage-gate relaxation
